supportingSource.title: UCSD FIS The Jeannie Second Floor inventory
supportingSource.use: Current inventory explicitly lists GA0205 on the second floor. Raster was unavailable; only the inventory is used for room/floor identity and independent area validation.

scale.name: Main front wall clear width
scale.note: Printed extension lines start at the front wall corners. The long horizontal dimension determines scale; no listed area is used to set it.

classroom.label: GA0205
boundaryNotes: Trace follows the lecture room perimeter, including the two rear seating bays. It excludes the central rear control/service enclosure and all four separate entrance vestibules.
Door openings are closed by straight lines at the jambs. Door swing arcs, seat rows, and red dimension lines are not room edges.
The curved rear wall is sampled at visible points. Structural corner boxes lie outside the trace. No seats, tier elevations or stepped floor surface are reconstructed.

limitations: The 2021 drawing is a historical source. The independently retrieved FIS inventory still directly identifies GA0205 and lists 5878 square feet; the actual current FIS raster was not accessible.
Only the auditorium room is modeled. The floor outline represents the available room extent, not a surveyed whole-building boundary. Other rooms and entrance vestibules are omitted.
No campus registration is supplied. Drawing orientation has no north arrow, so the local drawing axes must not be interpreted as verified geographic north.
The room is displayed on L2 according to the current FIS inventory; the seating drawing does not supply actual tier elevations or building heights. The inherited vertical height is estimated.
